root_cause: The three failing test jobs (TensorFlow Layer Tests, PyTorch Models tests, TensorFlow Models tests) all failed at the same step: downloading the 'openvino_wheels' artifact produced earlier in this same run via akashchi/download-artifact. The GitHub Actions artifact service returned a non-retryable 403 Forbidden 'from intermediary', which is a transient infra-side rejection unrelated to the artifact's actual availability - the upstream 'Build / Build' job completed successfully and uploaded the wheel artifact normally. This is unrelated to the PR under test (#38077), which only edits job_build_linux.yml to gate upload steps on producer step outcome; none of the failing jobs' logs reference that workflow file. Confirming the transient nature, run_attempt 2 of this same run re-ran the failed jobs without any code change and TensorFlow Layer Tests, TensorFlow Models tests, and (in progress) PyTorch Models tests all passed. The CPU functional tests failure is a separate, already-tracked flaky ACL primitive-type assertion (smoke_FC_3D_FP32/MatMulDecompressConvertTest, primTypeCheck undef_f32 vs acl_f32), matching a pattern seen previously on 2026-09-11 for a different test case, and unrelated to this PR.
reproduction_steps: N/A - not reproducible locally; requires the GitHub Actions Artifacts v4 backend returning a transient 403 from an intermediary proxy while downloading a same-run artifact.
recommended_actions: No code change required in PR #38077 - the failure is unrelated to the workflow-gating change under review.
Rely on the already-in-flight run_attempt 2, which is resolving the artifact-download failures without intervention.
If ListArtifacts 403 Forbidden recurs frequently across PRs, escalate to GitHub Support referencing the intermediary 403 error and the affected run IDs.

Track the CPU functional tests smoke_FC_3D_FP32/MatMulDecompressConvertTest ACL primType flake (undef_f32 vs acl_f32) alongside the existing similar case from 2026-09-11 for potential test-stabilization or disablement.
prevention_strategies: Add bounded retry/backoff around the download-artifact action for non-retryable 403 'from intermediary' responses (they are often transient despite being reported as non-retryable by the client library), so a single flaky artifact-service response does not fail an entire merge-queue run.
historical_context: Prior Infrastructure-category artifact-download failures exist for related but distinct errors: FinalizeArtifact 403 Forbidden (pattern 602c52a223d7ebfe, 2 occurrences) and ListArtifacts ECONNREFUSED (patterns 1808e665f1f70825/b889d24cd154d2dd, self-hosted runner network issue). This exact 'ListArtifacts ... 403 Forbidden' signature is being recorded as a new pattern. The CPU functional tests primTypeCheck flake matches pattern eb0b94c864ee1a85 (smoke_MaxPoolV8_CPU_4D, 2026-09-11) which reported the identical undef_f32 vs acl_f32 mismatch on a different test case.
